sentence_stem: If only I had listened to my teacher,
correct_completion: I would have passed the exam.
full_sentence: If only I had listened to my teacher, I would have passed the exam.
acceptable_variants: I would have done much better.

options.text: I will pass the exam tomorrow.
options.why_wrong: 'If only' plus past perfect expresses regret about the past. A future form does not fit this unreal past situation.
This is a real past fact. The sentence needs an unreal result that would have followed the missed action.

options.text: I would have passed the exam.
I can pass the exam now.
options.why_wrong: This describes present ability and has no link to the past regret expressed by 'if only'.

grammar_focus: Third conditional with 'if only' to express regret
explanation: 'If only' plus past perfect expresses regret about a past situation that did not happen. The result clause needs 'would have' plus a past participle. Ukrainian speakers may use a simple conditional here, but English requires 'would have' for an unreal past result.
translation: Якби я лише послухав свого вчителя, я б склав іспит.
